name: @w6w-apps/formbricks
description: Manage Formbricks surveys, responses, contacts, action classes and webhooks through the Management API on Formbricks Cloud.

w6w.longDescription:
Formbricks is an open-source survey and experience-management platform: link surveys, in-app and website surveys, and the contacts and attributes that let a team target and attribute feedback. This app drives the Formbricks Cloud Management API from a workflow.

It creates, reads, updates and deletes surveys and generates single-use links; lists, reads, creates, updates and deletes responses (which runs Formbricks' own response pipeline, so webhooks and follow-up emails fire); reads contacts, contact attributes and attribute keys; manages the action classes that trigger in-app surveys; and manages webhooks that call back when a response is created, updated or finished.

A key is bound to the workspaces you granted it, so every call stays within them. Health checks cover the Formbricks Cloud app, and the key's live rate-limit headroom.
